name: ai.wakeagents/wake
title: Wake
description: Read wakeagents.ai as an agent: about, search, read a page, get-started links to install or scan.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What this site is and where its main pages are: documentation, API, pricing, sign-up. Call this first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find pages on this site by topic. Returns titles, descriptions and URLs; read one with read_page.

query.description: What you are looking for, in a few words.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a page of this site as text. Pass a URL or a path on this site.

url.description: A URL or path on this site, for example /pricing.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: The links to download, install, sign up, see pricing or book a demo. Call this when the person wants to use or buy what this site offers, and give them the link.
